potential.name: OPLS-AA-based rigid LiPF6 / EC:EMC model + Werder sp2-C for the CNT; LJ + point charges; Lorentz-Berthelot mixing (recorded deviation from OPLS geometric sigma)

citations.used_for: OPLS-AA framework; terminal alkyl C (opls_135) LJ and uncharged alkyl sites for the EMC methyl tail

citations.used_for: ALTERNATIVE ONLY, NOT USED in the runs: Li+/SPC/E (Rmin/2 = 0.791 A, eps = 0.3367344 kcal/mol), re-verified from the local XML on 2026-10-14

protocol.thermostat: Nose-Hoover, damping 100 fs: fix rigid/nvt/small molecule on multi-atom bodies, fix nvt on Li+ atoms (identical targets/damping)

seeds.note: original planned seed set (20261001-04). During the resume, intermediate builds scanned other seeds after the EMC geometry fix; the pack-then-relax packer restored the original seeds. Data files were built with exactly these seeds.

outputs.dump_columns: id mol type q x y z (unscaled) + box bounds

bondi_floor.rule: intermolecular heavy-atom pairs >= 0.75 x Bondi vdW sum (ase set: C 1.70, O 1.52, Li 1.82, P 1.80, F 1.47 A); cation pairs exempt (ion solvation); H-involving pairs outside rule

deviations_and_notes: Molecules rigid (fixed literature geometry; LJ + point charges); no intra-molecular bonded dynamics - the documented first-result simplification allowed by the task.

EMC charges: the thesis EMC column does not sum to zero (+0.68 e with its own H typing); charges transplanted from the chemically equivalent EC sites + OPLS-AA uncharged alkyl tail, terminal methyl C absorbs the residual (exact neutrality). Verified against the local PDF on 2026-10-14.
Combining rule Lorentz-Berthelot (LAMMPS default; arithmetic sigma) - recorded deviation from strict OPLS-AA geometric sigma.
EC ring angle closure: thesis angles at the carbonate carbon (2x123.4 + 118.18 = 364.98 deg) cannot coexist; OC-CO-OS = 123.4 enforced on both sides, fixing OS-CO-OS = 113.2 deg.

EMC template REBUILT 2026-10-14: the original z-matrix builder placed the ethoxy OS 0.68 A from the carbonyl OC (enforced OC-CO-OS = 143.7/30.6 instead of 123.4 deg). The rebuild is an explicit planar construction asserting every bond/angle/dihedral of Table III (dihedrals: OC-CO-OS-CT = 0 deg ester s-cis; CO-OS-CT-CT = 180 deg anti ethyl, both documented conformer choices).
EMC H-bond wiring fixed (original bonded CT_me to the terminal-methyl H's; harmless because bonds are zero-force and molecule-intra neighbour exclusions supersede 1-2/1-3 terms, but wrong).

(16,16) composition trimmed 37/24 -> 36/23 (EC/EMC) after the EMC geometry fix: with the correct extended EMC, 37/24 exhausted 1M insertion attempts per molecule on every seed tried (20261003-38 range). 36/23 keeps EC:EMC 1:1 by volume (2401 vs 2394 volume units), the same 6 LiPF6 (same molarity), and a vdW-pore density closer to the bulk mixture.
cnt16 build seeds re-chosen by scan (see per-system seeds); the original seeds 20261003/20261004 were chosen against the broken EMC template.

Li+ integration: fix rigid/nvt/small (and fix rigid/nvt) reject single-particle bodies, so Li+ atoms carry their own Nose-Hoover fix nvt (same Tstart/Tstop/Tdamp); multi-atom molecules use fix rigid/nvt/small molecule. Found on first execution; the previous agent's input plan had never been run.
Velocities created at 10 K (the plan's 300 K create + 10 K ramp start was an internal inconsistency - quench-then-reheat).

Equilibration dump every 25 ps and thermo 500 added (equilibration evidence); thermo displays v_Tmob = 2KE/(DOF*kB) of the mobile subsystem because the default temperature is diluted by the frozen zero-velocity tube atoms.

Real-space intra-molecular nonbonded excluded (zero-K bonds + special_bonds 0 0 0 + neigh_modify exclude molecule/intra); the Ewald reciprocal intra-body term remains as a constant energy offset (zero net force/torque on rigid bodies).
Joung-Cheatham Li+ recorded as alternative only - the run uses the thesis Li+ so the whole electrolyte comes from one parameterization.
